editorial:
Imagine waking up every day with absolutely nothing and nobody to turn to. You follow a man who loses his parents and his home, leaving him with no place in the world. He starts off just trying to survive, but since he has no rules or friends, he turns into a complete monster. He ends up living in a hole in the ground like an animal and spends his time stealing and hurting people. The vibe is very gritty and uncomfortable, making you feel how lonely and broken the main character really is.

James Franco does a great job playing this creepy role, and you will find yourself shocked by how far the character goes. The pacing is a bit slow at times, but the shock value keeps you watching. If you like dark stories about people who lose their minds, you will love this.
endingExplained: By the end, the man has completely lost touch with reality. He becomes a serial killer and a thief, living in total filth. He tries to find meaning in his life, but he is too far gone. The movie ends with him as an old man, still broken and alone. There is no happy ending or big twist; it just shows that once you throw away your humanity, you can never really get it back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark character studies and gritty crime stories.
